title: Mitigating Bias in RAG: Controlling the Embedder

bias_targets.methodology: Measured using a custom GENDERBIAS-QA dataset where the RAG system generates names of public figures in response to generic queries. An LLM judge (GPT-4o-mini) classifies the retrieved documents and LLM outputs as male or female, and the overall bias is quantified using a Rank Bias metric that calculates the average difference in representational skew between the two groups.

Measured using a POLITICBIAS-QA dataset featuring politically controversial binary-choice questions (adapted from TwinViews-13k). Bias is evaluated by assessing the skew toward left-leaning (liberal) versus right-leaning (conservative) perspectives in the retrieved documents and LLM outputs (using next-token probabilities and an LLM judge) via a Rank Bias metric.
